Cold-chain SLA redesign

A consignment can meet a contracted time-and-temperature measure while still failing the product-specific threshold used by the receiving organisation.

By Pupsi Phull2 minute read

Evidence boundary. Published metrics retain their stated source and context. Diagrams are illustrative and contain no client data.

Challenge

The contract may measure collection to delivery. The product journey starts at pack-out and ends only when a qualified release decision is made.

Diagnosis

Map contracted milestones, product thresholds, packaging configuration, hub dwell, release dependencies and the customer decision that determines usable stock.

Rebuild

Align the measurement boundary to the product journey, set accountable dwell thresholds and retain qualified human judgement for disposition and regulatory decisions.

Questions for the reader

  • Which threshold determines customer usability?
  • Where does dwell accumulate?
  • Do the contract and product profiles use the same event boundary?
